facts.claim: 研究提出，需要一种通用方法来检测大语言模型的幻觉，而且应能处理新的、未见过的问题，包括人类可能也不知道答案的问题。
facts.quote: Researchers need a general method for detecting hallucinations in LLMs that works even with new and unseen questions to which humans might not know the answer.
facts.subject: Researchers
facts.condition: even with new and unseen questions to which humans might not know the answer

facts.claim: 通过监督或强化手段促使模型如实回答，此前仅取得部分成功。
facts.quote: Encouraging truthfulness through supervision or reinforcement has been only partially successful8.
facts.subject: Encouraging truthfulness through supervision or reinforcement

facts.claim: 研究提出基于统计学、以熵估计不确定性的方法，用于检测幻觉中的一类：既任意又错误的生成，作者称之为“confabulations”。
facts.quote: Here we develop new methods grounded in statistics, proposing entropy-based uncertainty estimators for LLMs to detect a subset of hallucinations—confabulations—which are arbitrary and incorrect generations.
facts.subject: entropy-based uncertainty estimators for LLMs
facts.condition: a subset of hallucinations—confabulations—which are arbitrary and incorrect generations

facts.claim: 考虑到同一个意思可以有多种表达，研究在意义层面而非具体词语序列层面计算不确定性。
facts.quote: Our method addresses the fact that one idea can be expressed in many ways by computing uncertainty at the level of meaning rather than specific sequences of words.
facts.subject: Our method
facts.condition: at the level of meaning rather than specific sequences of words

facts.claim: 作者报告，该方法能跨数据集和任务工作，不需要预先了解任务，也不需要任务专用数据，并能稳健地推广到此前未见过的新任务。
facts.quote: Our method works across datasets and tasks without a priori knowledge of the task, requires no task-specific data and robustly generalizes to new tasks not seen before.
facts.subject: Our method
facts.condition: across datasets and tasks without a priori knowledge of the task

facts.claim: 作者将研究对象限定为幻觉中的“confabulations”：模型流畅地给出既错误又任意的断言；这里的任意性是指答案会受随机种子等无关细节影响。
facts.quote:
We focus on a subset of hallucinations which we call
‘confabulations’12 for which LLMs fluently make claims that are both
wrong and arbitrary—by which we mean that the answer is sensitive
to irrelevant details such as random seed.
facts.subject: LLMs
facts.condition:
the answer is sensitive
to irrelevant details such as random seed

facts.claim: 原文以索托拉西布的靶点问题举例：在指令完全相同的情况下，模型有时回答正确的KRASG12 ‘C’，有时回答错误的KRASG12 ‘D’，用于说明答案的任意性。
facts.quote:
For example, when asked a
medical question “What is the target of Sotorasib?” an LLM confabu-
lates by sometimes answering KRASG12 ‘C’ (correct) and other times
KRASG12 ‘D’ (incorrect) despite identical instructions.
facts.subject: an LLM
facts.condition: despite identical instructions

facts.claim: 作者将这种任意且错误的生成，与因错误训练数据而持续答错、为追求奖励而“说谎”、以及推理或泛化的系统性失败区分开来。
facts.quote:
We distinguish
this from cases in which a similar ‘symptom’ is caused by the following
different mechanisms: when LLMs are consistently wrong as a result of
being trained on erroneous data such as common misconceptions13;
when the LLM ‘lies’ in pursuit of a reward14; or systematic failures of
reasoning or generalization.
facts.subject: LLMs
facts.condition: being trained on erroneous data such as common misconceptions13

facts.claim: 该方法不能保证输出符合事实，因为当模型输出存在系统性错误时，它无法提供帮助。
facts.quote:
However, it does not guarantee factuality
because it does not help when LLM outputs are systematically bad.
facts.subject: it
facts.condition: when LLM outputs are systematically bad

facts.claim: 作者报告，研究显著提高了当时先进大语言模型的问答准确率，并据此指出，这种任意且错误的生成是当前错误的重要来源。
facts.quote:
Nev-
ertheless, we significantly improve question-answering accuracy for
state-of-the-art LLMs, revealing that confabulations are a great source of
error at present.
facts.subject: state-of-the-art LLMs
facts.condition: at present

facts.claim: 研究通过建立定量指标，检测哪些输入容易使大语言模型生成任意且缺乏依据的答案。
facts.quote:
We show how to detect confabulations by developing a quantita -
tive measure of when an input is likely to cause an LLM to generate
arbitrary and ungrounded answers.
facts.subject: an input
facts.condition:
when an input is likely to cause an LLM to generate
arbitrary and ungrounded answers

facts.claim: 作者提出，检测这类生成可帮助基于大语言模型的系统避答容易引发此类错误的问题、提醒用户答案不可靠，或用依据更充分的搜索或检索补充模型。
facts.quote:
Detecting confabulations allows
systems built on LLMs to avoid answering questions likely to cause
confabulations, to make users aware of the unreliability of answers
to a question or to supplement the LLM with more grounded search
or retrieval.
facts.subject: systems built on LLMs
facts.condition: Detecting confabulations

facts.claim: 研究使用概率工具定义并测量“语义熵”，即在句子意义层面计算的熵。
facts.quote:
T o detect confabulations, we use probabilistic tools to define and
then measure the ‘semantic’ entropy of the generations of an LLM—an
entropy that is computed over meanings of sentences.
facts.subject: the generations of an LLM
facts.condition: computed over meanings of sentences

facts.claim: 高熵对应高不确定性，因此语义熵是估计语义不确定性的一种方式。
facts.quote:
High entropy
corresponds to high uncertainty23–25—so semantic entropy is one way
to estimate semantic uncertainties.
facts.subject: semantic entropy

facts.claim: 自由文本生成中，含义相同的答案可能采用不同表达，因此难以衡量熵；同一正确答案的多种措辞可能使朴素熵估计或词汇变化评分产生误导性的高值。
facts.quote: Entropy in free-form generation is normally hard to measure because answers might mean the same thing (be semantically equivalent) despite being expressed differently (being syntactically or lexically distinct). This causes naive estimates of entropy or other lexical variation scores26 to be misleadingly high when the same correct answer might be written in many ways without changing its meaning.
facts.subject: Entropy in free-form generation
facts.metric: naive estimates of entropy or other lexical variation scores26
facts.condition: when the same correct answer might be written in many ways without changing its meaning

facts.claim: 语义熵尝试估计自由回答的含义分布所对应的熵，而非模型原生表示的词或词片段分布所对应的熵；作者以“在可能范围内”限定这一目标。
facts.quote:
By contrast, our semantic entropy moves towards estimating the entropy of the distribution of meanings of free-form answers to ques-
tions, insofar as that is possible, rather than the distribution over the ‘tokens’ (words or word-pieces) which LLMs natively represent.
facts.subject: our semantic entropy
facts.metric: the entropy of the distribution of meanings
facts.condition: insofar as that is possible

facts.claim: 研究方法为每个问题采样多个可能答案，再按含义聚类；如果句子A能推出句子B为真，句子B也能反向推出句子A为真，就把二者归入同一语义簇。
facts.quote: Intuitively, our method works by sampling several possible answers to each question and clustering them algorithmically into answers that have similar meanings, which we determine on the basis of whether answers in the same cluster entail each other bidirectionally28. That is, if sentence A entails that sentence B is true and vice versa, then we consider them to be in the same semantic cluster.
facts.subject: our method
facts.condition: if sentence A entails that sentence B is true and vice versa
facts.strength: we consider them to be in the same semantic cluster

facts.claim: 研究使用通用大语言模型和专门用于检测蕴含关系的自然语言推断工具来衡量答案之间的蕴含关系，并在补充材料中提供直接评估。
facts.quote:
We measure entail-
ment using both general-purpose LLMs and natural language inference (NLI) tools developed specifically for detecting entailment for which we show direct evaluations in Supplementary Tables 2 and 3 and Sup-
plementary Fig. 1.
facts.subject: We
facts.condition: using both general-purpose LLMs and natural language inference (NLI) tools developed specifically for detecting entailment

facts.claim: 作者报告，语义熵能够在多种语言模型和领域的自由文本生成中检测编造内容，无需预先具备领域知识。
facts.quote:
Semantic entropy detects confabulations in free-form text genera-
tion across a range of language models and domains, without previous domain knowledge.
facts.subject: Semantic entropy
facts.condition: across a range of language models and domains, without previous domain knowledge

facts.claim: 问答评估覆盖TriviaQA的冷知识、SQuAD 1.1的一般知识、BioASQ的生命科学问题，以及源自真实Google搜索查询的NQ-Open开放域自然问题。
facts.quote: Our evaluations cover question answering in trivia knowledge (TriviaQA32), general knowledge (SQuAD 1.1; ref. 33), life sciences (BioASQ34) and open-domain natural questions (NQ-Open35) derived from actual queries to Google Search36.
facts.subject: Our evaluations
facts.condition: question answering in trivia knowledge (TriviaQA32), general knowledge (SQuAD 1.1; ref. 33), life sciences (BioASQ34) and open-domain natural questions (NQ-Open35) derived from actual queries to Google Search36

facts.claim: 作者还报告，语义熵能够检测SVAMP数学应用题和随论文提供的FactualBio人物传记生成数据集中的编造内容。
facts.quote:
In addition, seman-
tic entropy detects confabulations in mathematical word problems (SVAMP37) and in a biography-generation dataset, FactualBio, accom-
panying this paper.
facts.subject:
seman-
tic entropy
facts.condition:
in mathematical word problems (SVAMP37) and in a biography-generation dataset, FactualBio, accom-
panying this paper

facts.claim: TriviaQA、SQuAD、BioASQ、NQ-Open和SVAMP的结果均在不提供上下文的条件下评估，使用句子长度的答案，长度为96 ± 70字符（均值 ± 标准差）；所用模型包括LLaMA 2 Chat的7B、13B和70B参数版本、Falcon Instruct的7B和40B版本，以及Mistral Instruct的7B版本。
facts.quote:
Our results for TriviaQA, SQuAD, BioASQ, NQ-Open and SVAMP are all evaluated context-free and involve sentence-length answers (96 ± 70 characters, mean ± s.d.) and use LLaMA 2 Chat (7B, 13B and 70B param-
eters)38, Falcon Instruct (7B and 40B)39 and Mistral Instruct (7B)40.
facts.subject: Our results for TriviaQA, SQuAD, BioASQ, NQ-Open and SVAMP
facts.condition: all evaluated context-free

facts.claim: FactualBio实验使用GPT-4，文本长度为442 ± 122字符。
facts.quote: Results for FactualBio (442 ± 122 characters) use GPT-4 (ref. 1).
facts.subject: Results for FactualBio
facts.condition: use GPT-4 (ref. 1)

facts.claim: 论文写作时GPT-4尚未开放输出概率或隐藏状态，尽管文中说明此后已开放；因此作者提出语义熵估计量的离散近似，使实验无需访问输出概率。论文所有GPT-4结果均使用该近似，作者称其表现同样良好。
facts.quote:
At the time of writing, GPT-4 (ref. 1) did not expose output prob-
abilities41 or hidden states, although it does now. As a result, we propose a discrete approximation of our estimator for semantic entropy which allows us to run experiments without access to output probabilities, which we use for all GPT-4 results in this paper and which performs similarly well.
facts.subject: a discrete approximation of our estimator for semantic entropy
facts.condition: without access to output probabilities

facts.claim: 图1以“Paris”“It’s Paris”和“France’s capital Paris”为例：基于朴素熵的不确定性度量把这些措辞视为不同答案，而语义熵先把含义相同的答案聚类，再计算熵。低语义熵表示模型对答案的含义有信心。
facts.quote: a, Naive entropy-based uncertainty measures variation in the exact answers, treating ‘Paris’, ‘It’s Paris’ and ‘France’s capital Paris’ as different. But this is unsuitable for language tasks for which sometimes different answers mean the same things. Our semantic entropy clusters answers which share meanings before computing the entropy. A low semantic entropy shows that the LLM is confident about the meaning.
facts.subject: Our semantic entropy
facts.condition: language tasks for which sometimes different answers mean the same things
facts.strength: shows that the LLM is confident about the meaning

facts.claim: 处理较长文本时，研究先把生成的长答案自动拆成事实单元，再由大语言模型针对每个事实单元生成问题；原模型对这些问题采样M个可能答案，随后针对每个具体问题，将原事实单元也纳入答案集合来计算语义熵。
facts.quote: b , Semantic entropy can also detect confabulations in longer passages. We automatically decompose a long generated answer into factoids. For each factoid, an LLM generates questions to which that factoid might have been the answer. The original LLM then samples M possible answers to these questions. Finally, we compute the semantic entropy over the answers to each specific question, including the original factoid.
facts.subject: The original LLM
facts.metric: the semantic entropy over the answers to each specific question
facts.condition: including the original factoid

facts.claim: 在长文本检测流程中，如果与某一事实单元相关的问题具有较高的平均语义熵，就将其作为该事实单元可能包含编造内容的信号。
facts.quote: Confabulations are indicated by high average semantic entropy for questions associated with that factoid.
facts.subject: Confabulations
facts.condition: for questions associated with that factoid

facts.claim: 图1中，语义熵把事实1判为很可能不是编造，因为生成答案虽然措辞差异很大，却经常表达相同含义；作者指出朴素熵会漏掉这种含义一致性。
facts.quote: Here, semantic entropy classifies Fact 1 as probably not a confabulation because generations often mean the same thing, despite very different wordings, which a naive entropy would have missed.
facts.subject: semantic entropy
facts.condition: because generations often mean the same thing, despite very different wordings

facts.claim: 研究方法采用无监督方式，不需要已标注的编造回答示例。
facts.quote:
Our method is unsupervised, meaning that we do not 
need labelled examples of confabulations.
facts.subject: Our method

facts.claim: 研究采用嵌入回归作为较强的有监督比较基线：训练逻辑回归分类器，根据大语言模型最终的嵌入，即隐藏状态，预测模型是否正确回答了问题。
facts.quote:
As a strong supervised baseline, we compare 
to an embedding regression method inspired by ref. 24 which trains 
a logistic regression classifier to predict whether the model correctly 
answered a question on the basis of the final ‘embedding’ (hidden state) 
of the LLM.
facts.subject: an embedding regression method
facts.condition:
on the basis of the final ‘embedding’ (hidden state) 
of the LLM

facts.claim: 另一比较方法P(True)通过少量提示示例，让大语言模型比较主要答案和“头脑风暴”产生的备选答案，并考察模型预测下一个词元为“True”的概率。
facts.quote:
We also use the P(True) method24 which looks at the prob-
ability with which an LLM predicts that the next token is ‘True’ when 
few-shot prompted to compare a main answer with ‘brainstormed’ 
alternatives.
facts.subject: the P(True) method24
facts.metric:
the prob-
ability with which an LLM predicts that the next token is ‘True’
facts.condition:
when 
few-shot prompted to compare a main answer with ‘brainstormed’ 
alternatives

facts.claim: 研究表明，语义熵可用于预测许多错误回答，并通过拒绝回答模型不确定的问题来提高问答准确率。
facts.quote:
We show that semantic entropy can be used to pre-
dict many incorrect model answers and to improve question-answering 
accuracy by refusing to answer those questions the model is uncertain 
about.
facts.subject: semantic entropy
facts.condition:
by refusing to answer those questions the model is uncertain 
about

facts.claim: 研究用受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）评估对回答是否错误的判别表现；该指标范围为0至1，1表示完美分类器，0.5表示不能提供判别信息的分类器。这些数值表示检测指标，不是问答准确率。
facts.quote:
First, the widely used area under the receiver operating characteristic 
(AUROC) curve for the binary event that a given answer is incorrect. 
This measure captures both precision and recall and ranges from 
0 to 1, with 1 representing a perfect classifier and 0.5 representing 
an un-informative classifier.
facts.subject:
area under the receiver operating characteristic 
(AUROC) curve
facts.metric:
area under the receiver operating characteristic 
(AUROC) curve
facts.condition: for the binary event that a given answer is incorrect

facts.claim: 研究还采用拒答准确率曲线下面积（AURAC）：按编造检测分数拒绝回答最可能引起编造的问题，计算剩余问题的回答准确率，并对多个拒答阈值下的曲线作汇总。
facts.quote:
We also show a new measure, the area 
under the ‘rejection accuracy’ curve (AURAC). This studies the case in 
which the confabulation detection score is used to refuse to answer 
the questions judged most likely to cause confabulations. Rejection 
accuracy is the accuracy of the answers of the model on the remaining 
questions and the area under this curve is a summary statistic over 
many thresholds (representative threshold accuracies are provided in 
Supplementary Material).
facts.subject:
the area 
under the ‘rejection accuracy’ curve (AURAC)
facts.metric:
the accuracy of the answers of the model on the remaining 
questions
facts.condition:
the confabulation detection score is used to refuse to answer 
the questions judged most likely to cause confabulations

facts.claim: 对句子长度的生成内容，语义熵及其离散近似均优于研究中的最佳基线；结果是在留出的评估数据集上获得，并跨数据集取平均。
facts.quote:
In Fig. 2, we show that both semantic entropy and its discrete approxi-
mation outperform our best baselines for sentence-length generations. 
These results are averaged across datasets and provide the actual scores 
on the held-out evaluation dataset.
facts.subject:
both semantic entropy and its discrete approxi-
mation
facts.condition: for sentence-length generations

facts.claim: 研究报告留出评估数据集上的原始平均分数，未附标准误；作者给出的理由是，分布特征更多取决于所选模型和数据集，而非方法本身，并认为不同数据集间相对结果的一致性在此更能反映变异情况。
facts.quote:
We report the raw average score 
across held-out evaluation datasets without standard error because 
the distributional characteristics are more a property of the models 
and datasets selected than the method. Consistency of relative results 
across different datasets is a stronger indicator of variation in this case.
facts.subject: the raw average score
facts.condition: across held-out evaluation datasets

facts.claim: 语义熵明显优于朴素熵估计。这里的朴素方法计算经长度归一化的词元序列联合概率的熵，却忽略了词元概率还反映不改变输出含义的措辞变化所带来的不确定性。
facts.quote:
Semantic entropy greatly outperforms the naive estimation of uncer-
tainty using entropy: computing the entropy of the length-normalized 
joint probability of the token sequences. Naive entropy estimation 
ignores the fact that token probabilities also express the uncertainty of 
the model over phrasings that do not change the meaning of an output.
facts.subject: Semantic entropy
facts.condition:
computing the entropy of the length-normalized 
joint probability of the token sequences

facts.claim: 研究提出的方法在分布内和分布外两种情况下，均优于有监督的嵌入回归方法。
facts.quote:
Our methods also outperform the supervised embedding regression 
method both in- and out-of-distribution.
facts.subject: Our methods
facts.condition: both in- and out-of-distribution

facts.claim: 当训练数据与部署时的数据分布不匹配时，嵌入回归的性能下降。图中相应数值是对使用四个分布外数据集之一训练的嵌入回归所得到的指标取平均。
facts.quote:
In pale-yellow bars we show 
that embedding regression performance deteriorates when its train-
ing data do not match the deployment distribution—which mirrors the 
common real-world case in which there is a distribution shift between 
training and deployment42—the plotted value is the average metric for 
embedding regression trained on one of the four ‘off-distribution’ 
datasets for that evaluation.
facts.subject: embedding regression
facts.condition:
when its train-
ing data do not match the deployment distribution

facts.claim: 语义熵也优于P(True)；后者通过在大语言模型提示中提供少量训练示例，以有监督的上下文方式适应部署任务。
facts.quote:
Semantic entropy 
also outperforms P(True) which is supervised ‘in-context’; that is, it is 
adapted to the deployment task with a few training examples provided 
in the LLM prompt itself.
facts.subject: Semantic entropy
facts.condition: P(True) which is supervised ‘in-context’

facts.claim: 语义熵的离散版本无需精确的输出概率，表现仍与标准估计方法相近。
facts.quote:
The discrete variant of semantic entropy per-
forms similarly to our standard estimator, despite not requiring exact 
output probabilities.
facts.subject: The discrete variant of semantic entropy
facts.condition:
despite not requiring exact 
output probabilities

facts.claim: 在研究的30种任务与模型组合上取平均，语义熵的AUROC最高，为0.790；朴素熵为0.691，P(True)为0.698，嵌入回归基线为0.687。这些数值是错误回答检测的AUROC，不是回答正确率。
facts.quote:
Averaged across the 30 combinations of tasks and models we study, 
semantic entropy achieves the best AUROC value of 0.790 whereas 
naive entropy (0.691), P(True) (0.698) and the embedding regression 
baseline (0.687) lag behind it.
facts.subject: semantic entropy
facts.condition: Averaged across the 30 combinations of tasks and models we study

facts.claim: 图2的结果是五个数据集上的平均值，各项单独指标见补充信息。
facts.quote:
Results are an average over five 
datasets, with individual metrics provided in the Supplementary Information.
facts.subject: Results

facts.claim: 本页所述研究覆盖LLaMA、Falcon和Mistral模型家族，模型规模从7B到70B参数，并按数据集和模型报告汇总统计。
facts.quote:
across the different model families (LLaMA, Falcon and Mistral) and 
scales (from 7B to 70B parameters) which we study (we report summary 
statistics for each dataset and model as before).
facts.subject: different model families (LLaMA, Falcon and Mistral)
facts.condition: for each dataset and model

facts.claim: 语义熵在所研究的所有模型规模上均优于基线方法。P (True)的表现似乎随模型规模增大而改善；作者据此提出，在能力很强、诚实且充分理解任务情境的模型中，它可能更具竞争力，但这些并非最需要良好不确定性判断的情境。
facts.quote:
Although semantic 
entropy outperforms the baselines across all model sizes, P (True) 
seems to improve with model size, suggesting that it might become 
more competitive for very capable honest models in settings that the 
model understands well (which are, however, not the most important 
cases to have good uncertainty).
facts.subject:
semantic 
entropy
facts.condition: across all model sizes

facts.claim: 研究使用十次生成来计算熵，这一生成次数依据补充图2中的分析选定。
facts.quote:
We use ten generations to compute 
entropy, selected using analysis in Supplementary Fig. 2.
facts.subject: We
facts.condition: selected using analysis in Supplementary Fig. 2

facts.claim: 作者将图2的结果视为语义熵检测编造错误有效性的下界；这里的编造错误指任意性的错误回答。
facts.quote:
The results in Fig. 2 offer a lower bound on the effectiveness of seman-
tic entropy at detecting confabulations. These evaluations determine 
whether semantic entropy and baseline methods can detect when the 
answers of the model are incorrect (which we validate against human 
correctness evaluations in Supplementary Table 4). In addition to errors 
from confabulations (arbitrary incorrectness), this also includes other 
types of mistakes for which semantic entropy is not suited, such as 
consistent errors learned from the training data.
facts.subject: The results in Fig. 2
facts.condition: at detecting confabulations

facts.claim: 这些评估检验语义熵和基线方法能否检测模型回答错误，并用人工正确性评估进行验证；评估目标包括编造错误，也包括从训练数据中学到的稳定错误等语义熵不适合检测的错误。
facts.quote:
These evaluations determine 
whether semantic entropy and baseline methods can detect when the 
answers of the model are incorrect (which we validate against human 
correctness evaluations in Supplementary Table 4). In addition to errors 
from confabulations (arbitrary incorrectness), this also includes other 
types of mistakes for which semantic entropy is not suited, such as 
consistent errors learned from the training data.
facts.subject: semantic entropy and baseline methods
facts.condition:
when the 
answers of the model are incorrect

facts.claim: 嵌入回归等方法能够识别编造以外的其他错误，却仍被语义熵超越；作者认为，这提示编造错误是实际生成内容中一个主要的错误类别。
facts.quote:
The fact that methods 
such as embedding regression are able to spot other kinds of errors, not 
just confabulations, but still are outperformed by semantic entropy, 
suggests that confabulations are a principal category of errors for 
actual generations.
facts.subject:
methods 
such as embedding regression
facts.condition:
for 
actual generations

facts.claim: 表1使用LLaMA 2 Chat 70B在TriviaQA、SQuAD和BioASQ上的问答示例，展示不同生成内容下语义熵与朴素熵的判断；朴素熵在这些示例中未将含义相同但措辞不同的回答合为一类。
facts.quote:
Examples of questions and answers from TriviaQA, SQuAD and 
BioASQ, for LLaMA 2 Chat 70B, are shown in Table 1. These illustrate 
how only semantic entropy detects when the meaning is constant 
but the form varies (the first row of the table) whereas semantic 
entropy and naive entropy both correctly predict the presence of 
confabulations when the form and meaning vary together (second 
row) and predict the absence of confabulations when the form and 
meaning are both constant across several resampled generations 
(third row).
facts.subject: LLaMA 2 Chat 70B
facts.condition:
from TriviaQA, SQuAD and 
BioASQ

facts.claim: 表1第一行展示：多个回答虽然措辞不同，但含义相同，因而被语义熵方法归为同一组；语义熵正确判断没有编造错误，而朴素熵会误判存在编造错误。这里的分组就是把含义相同的回答放在一起。
facts.quote:
The first row of Table 1 demonstrates a case in which semantic entropy correctly predicts that an answer is not a confabulation if naive entropy would incorrectly predict a confabulation. All of 
the generations from the model mean the same thing as each other so they are clustered together despite using different phrasings.
facts.subject: semantic entropy
facts.condition:
All of 
the generations from the model mean the same thing as each other

facts.claim: 表1第二行展示：各次生成在措辞和含义上均不同，语义熵与朴素熵都会正确判断存在编造错误。
facts.quote:
The second row provides an example in which semantic 
entropy and naive entropy would both correctly predict a confabulation, in which each generation is both lexically distinct and also means something different.
facts.subject:
semantic 
entropy and naive entropy
facts.condition: each generation is both lexically distinct and also means something different

facts.claim: 表1第三行展示：多次生成的措辞几乎相同，语义熵与朴素熵都会正确判断没有编造错误。
facts.quote:
The third row is an example in 
which semantic entropy and naive entropy would both correctly predict no confabulation because the multiple generations are almost lexically identical.
facts.subject: semantic entropy and naive entropy
facts.condition: the multiple generations are almost lexically identical

facts.claim: 表1最后一行展示了语义熵误判偏高的情况：相对于参考答案，按含义分组的方法过于敏感，把给出具体日期的回答和只给出年份的回答分开；作者认为，在这一语境中，两者的差别可能无关紧要。
facts.quote:
In the final row, we give an example in which semantic 
entropy is erroneously high as a result of overly sensitive semantic 
clustering relative to the reference answer. Our clustering method 
distinguishes the answers which provide a precise date from those 
which only provide a year. For some contexts that would have been 
correct but in this context the distinction between the specific day 
and the year is probably irrelevant.
facts.subject:
semantic 
entropy
facts.condition: in this context

facts.claim: 作者指出，按含义对回答分组需要考虑语境并作出判断，细微情况尤其如此；使用固定参考答案进行评估也有不足，因为这种答案无法体现大语言模型在对话应用中回答的开放性和灵活性。
facts.quote:
This highlights the importance 
of context and judgement in clustering, especially in subtle cases, as 
well as the shortcomings of evaluating against fixed reference answers 
which do not capture the open-ended flexibility of conversational 
deployments of LLMs.
facts.subject: evaluating against fixed reference answers
facts.condition: especially in subtle cases

facts.claim: 语义熵最自然地适用于表达单一命题的句子，即只表达一项可判断内容的句子。较长段落包含多个命题，这些命题可能只部分一致，因此判断语义是否等价更困难。
facts.quote:
Semantic entropy is most natural for sentences that express a single 
proposition but the idea of semantic equivalence is trickier to apply to 
longer passages which express many propositions which might only 
agree partially43.
facts.subject: Semantic entropy
facts.condition:
sentences that express a single 
proposition

facts.claim: 为展示语义熵也能用于检测整段文字等较长生成内容中的编造错误，研究构建了GPT-4（v.0613）生成的人物传记数据集，涉及21人；这些人均有自己的维基百科页面，但网上没有大量传记资料。
facts.quote:
Nevertheless, we can use semantic entropy to detect 
confabulations in longer generations, such as entire paragraphs of text. 
T o show this, we develop a dataset of biographical generations from 
GPT-4 (v.0613) for 21 individuals notable enough to have their own 
Wikipedia page but without extensive online biographies.
facts.subject: GPT-4 (v.0613)
facts.condition:
notable enough to have their own 
Wikipedia page but without extensive online biographies

facts.claim: 研究包含关于个人的共150条事实性陈述，由研究者手动标注为真或假。
facts.quote:
factual claims about the individual (150 factual claims in total), which 
we manually label as true or false.
facts.subject: factual claims about the individual

facts.claim: 直接重新生成人物传记中的句子会遇到一个问题：不同生成结果可能分别谈家庭和职业，反映的是事实排列次序的不确定，而非事实本身的不确定。
facts.quote:
However, the resampled sentences often target different aspects of 
the biography: for example, one time describing family and the next 
time profession. This is analogous to the original problem semantic 
entropy was designed to resolve: the model is uncertain about the right 
ordering of facts, not about the facts themselves.
facts.subject: the resampled sentences
facts.condition: the biography

facts.claim: 研究将整段文字拆解为事实性陈述，并反推这些陈述可能回答的问题；随后为每个问题生成三个新答案，将它们与原始陈述一起用于计算语义熵，即考虑表达含义的不确定性指标。
facts.quote:
T o address this, we 
break down the entire paragraph into factual claims and reconstruct 
questions which might have been answered by those claims. Only then 
do we apply semantic entropy (Fig. 1) by generating three new answers 
to each question (selected with analysis in Supplementary Figs. 3 and 4) 
and computing the semantic entropy over those generations plus the 
original factual claim.
facts.subject: we
facts.condition: to each question

facts.claim: 研究对所有相关问题的语义熵取平均，为每个命题得到一个不确定性分数，并用它检测编造内容。
facts.quote:
We aggregate these by averaging the semantic 
entropy over all the questions to get an uncertainty score for each 
proposition, which we use to detect confabulations.
facts.subject: We
facts.condition:
for each 
proposition

facts.claim: 由于写作时无法获取GPT-4生成结果的概率，研究采用离散版语义熵；其额外近似是仅凭生成结果推断语义含义分组上的离散经验分布，因此可以只使用模型的黑箱输出计算语义熵。
facts.quote:
As GPT-4 did not allow access to the probability of the generation 
at the time of writing, we use a discrete variant of semantic entropy 
which makes the further approximation that we can infer a discrete 
empirical distribution over semantic meaning clusters from only the 
generations (Methods). This allows us to compute semantic entropy 
using only the black-box outputs of an LLM.
facts.subject: we
facts.condition: using only the black-box outputs of an LLM

facts.claim: 由于无法获得GPT-4的输出概率和嵌入表示，研究无法为其计算朴素熵基线、标准语义熵估计量和嵌入回归基线。
facts.quote:
However, we were unable 
to compute the naive entropy baseline, the standard semantic entropy 
estimator or the embedding regression baseline for GPT-4 without 
output probabilities and embeddings.
facts.subject: we
facts.metric:
the naive entropy baseline, the standard semantic entropy 
estimator or the embedding regression baseline
facts.condition:
for GPT-4 without 
output probabilities and embeddings

facts.claim: 在该数据集上，离散版语义熵的AUROC和AURAC这两项检测表现指标均高于两种基线：直接询问模型事实是否可能为真的自检方法，以及适配段落长度场景的P(True)变体。这里的比较指标不是答案准确率。
facts.quote:
Its AUROC and AURAC are 
higher than either a simple ‘self-check’ baseline—which just asks the 
LLM whether the factoid is likely to be true—or a variant of P(True) which 
has been adapted to work for the paragraph-length setting.
facts.subject: Its
facts.condition: the paragraph-length setting

facts.claim: 按拒绝部分问题后剩余答案的准确率比较，离散语义熵在拒绝比例达到20%之前表现更好；达到这一比例时，P(True)略占优势。
facts.quote:
Discrete 
semantic entropy has better rejection accuracy performance until 
20% of the questions have been rejected at which point P(True) has 
a narrow edge.
facts.subject:
Discrete 
semantic entropy
facts.condition:
until 
20% of the questions have been rejected

facts.claim: 作者据此指出，被预测会导致编造回答的问题确实更可能得到错误回答。
facts.quote:
This indicates that the questions predicted to cause 
confabulations are indeed more likely to be wrong.
facts.subject:
the questions predicted to cause 
confabulations

facts.claim: 作者将方法的检测范围界定为一类重要的幻觉：由大语言模型缺乏知识造成的错误；该概率方法在计算时考虑表达在含义上是否等价。
facts.quote:
Our probabilistic approach, accounting for semantic equivalence, 
detects an important class of hallucinations: those that are caused by a 
lack of LLM knowledge.
facts.subject: Our probabilistic approach
facts.condition:
those that are caused by a 
lack of LLM knowledge

facts.claim: 该方法明确不直接处理模型自信但错误的情形，包括训练目标系统性地产生危险行为、造成系统性推理错误，或模型系统性地误导用户的情形。
facts.quote:
Our method explicitly does not directly address situations in 
which LLMs are confidently wrong because they have been trained 
with objectives that systematically produce dangerous behaviour, 
cause systematic reasoning errors or are systematically mislead -
ing the user.
facts.subject: Our method
facts.condition:
situations in 
which LLMs are confidently wrong

facts.claim: 图3针对GPT-4生成的段落长度人物传记显示：在回答超过80%的问题时，语义熵方法的答案准确率最高；只有拒绝最可能属于编造的前20%答案后，P(True)基线在剩余答案上的准确率才超过语义熵方法。80%指回答问题的比例，20%指拒绝答案的比例。
facts.quote:
At above 
80% of questions being answered, semantic entropy has the highest accuracy. 
Only when the top 20% of answers judged most likely to be confabulations are 
rejected does the answer accuracy on the remainder for the P(True) baseline 
exceed semantic entropy.
facts.subject: semantic entropy
facts.condition:
At above 
80% of questions being answered
